title: Mute, bypass, reroutes and groups: what the server really gets
hook: Bypass rewires the graph, Mute cuts it, and reroutes and groups never reach the graph the server runs. See the JSON each one produces.

verified.claim: Muted and bypassed nodes, and virtual nodes, are left out of the API graph, and a wire to a dropped node is removed.
verified.ref: ComfyUI front end main branch at commit 4b24c63, src/utils/executionUtil.ts:graphToPrompt, fetched 2026-11-01

verified.claim: A bypassed node passes on an input: the same slot number if the types fit, else the first input of the wanted type, else the first that fits, else nothing.
verified.ref: front end main branch, ExecutableNodeDTO.resolveOutput and _getBypassSlotIndex, fetched 2026-11-01

verified.claim: Mode numbers are 0 ALWAYS, 2 NEVER and 4 BYPASS. Ctrl+B and Ctrl+M toggle Bypass and Mute. The group menu has Set Group Nodes to Always, Never and Bypass Group Nodes.
verified.ref: front end main branch, globalEnums.ts, keybindings/defaults.ts, groupOptions.ts, fetched 2026-11-01

verified.claim: Reroute and Note set isVirtualNode, and neither is a server node: posting a Reroute gives missing_node_type.
verified.ref: execution.validate_prompt on hand-written prompts, and rerouteNode.ts and noteNode.ts

verified.claim: Removing the blur's wire gives required_input_missing, a wire to an absent node fails validation, and removing the only output gives prompt_no_outputs.
Extra fields in _meta are ignored by validation.
The docs describe Never as 'as if it's been deleted', and Bypass as not executing while later nodes can still try to obtain data.

unchecked: The front-end rules come from reading its main branch. We did not press these keys in a browser and export the result, and the installed bundle may be an older version than main.
Our port leaves out subgraphs. Bypass and Mute on a subgraph node go through extra code that we read only in part.
Bypass rules for nodes whose inputs have list types use the editor's own connection test, and our port compares types by plain equality.
